categoryDescriptions.home: Access the main dashboard with business metrics and summary.
categoryDescriptions.analytics: View and export analytics and performance reports.
categoryDescriptions.settlements: Manage settlements, cash register cuts, and balances.
categoryDescriptions.reports: Access detailed sales and operations reports.
categoryDescriptions.menu: Create, edit, and delete menu products and categories.
categoryDescriptions.payments: Process payments, refunds, and view transactions.
categoryDescriptions.products: Manage products for Scan & Go and catalog.
categoryDescriptions.shifts: Open, close, and manage staff shifts.
categoryDescriptions.tpv: Configure and manage point of sale terminals.
categoryDescriptions.inventory: Control stock levels, ingredients, and inventory movements.
categoryDescriptions.reviews: View and respond to customer reviews.
categoryDescriptions.teams: Invite, edit roles, and manage team members.
categoryDescriptions.tables: Configure tables, zones, and venue layout.
categoryDescriptions.venues: Configure venue information, hours, and tax details.
categoryDescriptions.billing: View and manage subscriptions, payment methods, and billing.
categoryDescriptions.customers: View, create, and manage customer profiles.
categoryDescriptions.customer_groups: Create and manage customer groups for segmentation.
categoryDescriptions.loyalty: Configure and manage loyalty programs and points.
categoryDescriptions.discounts: Create and manage discounts and promotions.
categoryDescriptions.coupons: Create, edit, and manage discount coupons.
categoryDescriptions.credit_packs: Sell and redeem prepaid packages (classes, sessions, memberships) and manage their catalog.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_settings: Configure general point of sale terminal options.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_terminal: Configure devices, printers, and terminal peripherals.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_orders: Advanced order operations from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_payments: Advanced payment operations from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_shifts: Manage shifts directly from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_tables: Manage tables and assignments from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_customers: Search and manage customers from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_time_entries: Track staff clock-in and clock-out times.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_reports: View sales and performance reports from the terminal.
categoryDescriptions.tpv_products: Manage products for quick scanning (Scan & Go).
categoryDescriptions.tpv_factory_reset: Reset the terminal to factory settings. Critical and irreversible action.
categoryDescriptions.accounting: View, reconcile and manage the venue accounting.
categoryDescriptions.cash_out: View and perform cash withdrawals, and see their reports.
categoryDescriptions.estimates: Create estimates without turning them into a sale.
categoryDescriptions.manual_sales: Record sales entered by hand, outside the checkout flow.
categoryDescriptions.payment_link: Create and manage payment links to send to customers.
categoryDescriptions.tender_types: Manage the venue custom payment types (vouchers, transfers).
categoryDescriptions.sale_verifications: Review, approve and correct sales that require verification.
categoryDescriptions.upsells: Manage the upsell suggestions shown at checkout.
categoryDescriptions.printers: View and configure receipt and kitchen printers.
categoryDescriptions.delivery_channels: Manage delivery channels and request new ones.
categoryDescriptions.catalog_venue: View the venue catalog and request price overrides.
categoryDescriptions.calendar: Connect calendars and manage the venue one.
categoryDescriptions.platform_billing: View, configure and issue platform billing.
categoryDescriptions.cfdi: Configure, stamp and view CFDI invoices.
categoryDescriptions.venue_fiscal_profile: Manage the fiscal data used for invoicing.

permissionLabels.creditPacks_sell: Sell a package at the counter
permissionLabels.creditPacks_redeem: Redeem a session from a package
permissionLabels.cash-drawer_view-expected: See expected drawer cash (not a blind count)

permissionDescriptions.tpv_command: Enables the specific remote command options below.
permissionDescriptions.tpv_command_wipe: Permanently deletes all data on the device. This action cannot be undone.
permissionDescriptions.tpv_command_shutdown: The device will need to be physically powered on to use again.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-factory-reset_execute: Resets the device to its original factory settings. All local data will be lost.
permissionDescriptions.payments_refund: Allows processing partial or full refunds on completed transactions.
permissionDescriptions.inventory_adjust: Allows manual quantity adjustments without creating a purchase order.
permissionDescriptions.customers_settle-balance: Allows marking pending accounts receivable balances as paid.
permissionDescriptions.commissions_payout: Allows processing approved commission payments to employees.
permissionDescriptions.commissions_view_own: Employees can view their own commissions and sales goals.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-payments_pay-later: Allows the customer to receive their order without paying. Creates an account receivable.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-kiosk_enable: Activates self-service mode for customers to place orders directly.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-orders_comp: Only available on the POS app.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-orders_void: Only available on the POS app.
permissionDescriptions.tpv-orders_discount: Only available on the POS app.
permissionDescriptions.settings_manage: Includes roles, permissions, integrations, and general venue settings.
permissionDescriptions.teams_invite: Sends an email invitation to join the venue's team.
permissionDescriptions.loyalty_redeem: Allows redeeming accumulated points at checkout.
permissionDescriptions.shifts_close: Generates the cash register cut with the shift's sales summary.
permissionDescriptions.orders_merge: Allows combining two open checks into one and closing the source check. This cannot be undone.
permissionDescriptions.cash-drawer_view-expected: Sees during the day how much cash should be in the physical drawer. Without it the cashier counts blind and sees the result on close.

externalRoute.sectionDescription: By default, Avoqado charges and records every area's tickets. Change this only if another checkout at the venue already charges on its own.
externalRoute.cardSubtitle: Where this area's tickets get charged
externalRoute.toggleDescription: Another point of sale, at a different checkout, charges this area's tickets instead of Avoqado.
externalRoute.statusAvoqado: Avoqado charges and records this area's tickets.
externalRoute.statusExternal: Another checkout charges this area's tickets.
externalRoute.noPermission: You don't have permission to change this. Ask a venue administrator.
externalRoute.viewQueueLink: View charges to confirm and incidents
externalRoute.policiesDisabledNote: These policies only apply when another checkout charges this area's tickets.

confirmDialog.title: Change the settlement route?
confirmDialog.description: This area's tickets will be charged at another checkout. Avoqado will not record those sales or issue an invoice for them.

confirmationMode.label: How the charge is confirmed
confirmationMode.manualHint: A staff member with permission confirms the charge; until they do, the ticket stays pending.
confirmationMode.assumeOnPrintPending: “Assumed charged on print” can't be selected yet: the Android and iPhone apps are what record the print, and it ships with their next release.
confirmationMode.assumeOnPrintStuck: This area is saved as “Assumed charged on print”, a mode that doesn't work yet: its charges stay pending confirmation and no incident is opened. Switch it to “Someone confirms it by hand”.

offlinePolicy.label: Tickets while offline
offlinePolicy.pendingHint: No effect yet: the Android and iPhone apps are what know the area lost its connection, and it ships with their next release. Today the area issues tickets the same way under either option.

deliveryTracking.label: Delivery tracking
deliveryTracking.trackedHint: Every delivery is recorded and shows up in the pending queue.
deliveryTracking.untrackedHint: The area hands it over by checking the paper ticket; nothing is recorded, no queue.

externalSettlements.title: External charges
externalSettlements.subtitle: Which external-route charges nobody has confirmed yet, and which incidents are still open. Read-only: nothing here confirms or resolves anything.
externalSettlements.referenceDisclaimer: These numbers are the reference amount Avoqado calculated for each ticket — not Avoqado sales: that money went into another point of sale's register and is not added to your sales reports.
externalSettlements.incidentDisclaimer: The system opens these incidents on its own, whenever something on the external route needs a person to review it — a charge nobody confirmed in time, an amount mismatch. No action on this screen confirms or resolves anything yet.
externalSettlements.emptyDefault: No charges are waiting to be confirmed right now. External-route tickets that nobody has confirmed yet will show up here.
externalSettlements.emptyFiltered: No external charge matches these filters. Try different filters or clear them to see more.
externalSettlements.incidentEmptyDefault: No incidents are open. Problems the system detects on its own — an external charge nobody confirmed in time, an amount mismatch — will show up here for someone to review.
externalSettlements.incidentEmptyFiltered: No incident matches these filters. Try different filters or clear them to see more.
